categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Only includes a release note accompanying the mining interface change.
categories.rationale: Release notes accompanying code changes belong to the code's area, not the docs category.

categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches Cap'n Proto mining schemas (src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp), but only to expose a new argument on the mining interface.
categories.rationale: The IPC category explicitly excludes changes whose subject is what the mining interface exposes rather than IPC infrastructure itself.

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Keyword match only; does not touch mempool policy or data structures.
categories.rationale: Does not affect transaction acceptance, eviction, or mempool policy.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label, modifies src/interfaces/mining.h, src/node/miner.cpp, and adds functional IPC mining tests.
categories.rationale: Allows IPC mining clients to atomically submit and prefer a block in a single call, eliminating round-trips and a race window against concurrent chain activations.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp merely to adapt to an updated PreciousBlock return signature.
categories.rationale: The minimal RPC change is a mechanical consequence of modifying PreciousBlock's signature.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Deduplicates GrindBlock across unit tests and adds test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py.
categories.rationale: Tests specific to the mining IPC interface belong to the mining area rather than test framework infrastructure.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Extracts ActivateBestChain_ helper and updates PreciousBlock in src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Changes in src/validation are minor locking refactors to serve mining block submission, which the validation category explicitly delegates to mining.
